prompts: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: attached AKUROTH illustrated reference sheet. Produce ONLY the phase 1 character on the LEFT, O Portador do Vazio, as one isolated full-body character reference for image-to-3D. Preserve his recognizable face, wild black hair, red eyes, jagged black armor with crimson accents, gold chains, long layered torn black and dark-red cloak and robes, dark shadow-forged sword with red fissures and eclipse-like core. Faithfully reconstruct portions obscured by UI. Show complete head, both boots, entire blade and cloak edges, no cropping, generous transparent margin. Relaxed near-front three-quarter A stance, arms slightly apart, sword held down away from legs so silhouette is clear. Detailed dark fantasy anime illustration matching the supplied design, even neutral studio illumination to read shapes and materials, restrained localized red glow. Exactly one character, two anatomical arms. Remove ALL lettering, title, frames, ability thumbnails, UI, scenery, eclipses in the sky, particles, ground and background. Actual transparent alpha background. Do not add a second form, panels or extra props. Keep the original character identity, colors and costume; this is an isolated phase-one modeling reference, not a redesign.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: attached AKUROTH illustrated reference sheet. Produce ONLY the phase 2 character on the RIGHT, Soberano do Absoluto, as one isolated full-body reference for image-to-3D. Preserve the same character identity and illustrated appearance: extremely long flowing white hair, sinister face, black horned jagged crown, muscular pale torso with dark armor and black-red markings, red eclipse core in his chest, elaborate gold chains, long torn layered black/crimson garments and boots. Include two main anatomical arms and SIX additional distinct shadow arms emerging from his back in a readable symmetric fan (three per side), long black-red fingers and tapered shadow shapes faithful to the reference; separate each silhouette clearly. Calm frontal or slight three-quarter modeling stance, no lunging, complete crown, boots, hair ends, garment and shadow-arm tips visible, generous transparent margin. Detailed dark fantasy anime illustration matching the source, evenly lit for shape readability; restrained crimson glow without obscuring anatomy. Reconstruct obscured lower body faithfully. Exactly ONE phase-two character. Remove ALL text, UI, borders, bar, ability thumbnails, ground, environment, sky eclipses, floating orbs, external circles, loose particles and smoke. Actual transparent alpha background. No side-by-side panels, no second character, no large background VFX. Preserve design rather than inventing a different boss.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D environment modeling reference for the same AKUROTH boss arena, phase 1. Input attached sheet is an ART STYLE and architecture reference only; do NOT reproduce its characters, UI or text. Create a single coherent 3D-buildable dark Gothic ruin arena as a detached architectural diorama seen from a clear elevated three-quarter angle. A broad circular fractured black-stone battle platform with a spacious EMPTY mostly level fighting center, worn concentric stone slabs and subtle crimson seams. Around its perimeter: six ruined tall Gothic columns, broken pointed arches, a short stairway entrance, carved stone plinths, sparse rubble and a few iron chains connected to architecture. Restrained dark-red braziers at outer edges. Faithful black/charcoal stone, aged dark metal, muted gold ornamental accents, deep red eclipse illumination consistent with AKUROTH phase one. Readable geometry, clear top surfaces, clean silhouette and subtle ambient occlusion, high-quality detailed fantasy illustration / environment concept. Isolate the entire diorama on an actual TRANSPARENT background, all bases/columns and platform edges fully visible with margin. No people, monsters, boss, heroes, weapons on ground, UI, labels, written symbols, title, floating HUD, ability art, sky backdrop, large smoke, particle clouds or an eclipse sphere object. One arena scene, not a collage or multiple views. Practical shapes for image-to-3D reconstruction, no unconnected floating debris.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D environment modeling reference for AKUROTH phase 2, the infernal version of the ruin arena. Input attached sheet supplies palette and Gothic architecture only; do NOT include its people or UI. Create ONE coherent isolated architectural arena diorama in an elevated three-quarter view, same circular platform language as phase one, transformed into a somber hellish abyss. Broad EMPTY playable fighting center of scorched black basalt slabs, deep crimson glowing cracks and a shattered carved eclipse insignia integrated into stone (not lettering). Perimeter lava trench with visible solid rock borders, obsidian spires, broken Gothic pillars and arches, heavy chains anchored between columns, jagged dark altar behind the platform, limited intense flames in perimeter braziers, black-red mineral deposits. Terrain must form a coherent self-contained buildable diorama, no disconnected floating chunks. Palette black, ash charcoal, dark blood red, glowing orange-red lava, subtle violet edge light. Detailed cinematic dark fantasy environment illustration, structure and surfaces legible, coherent shadows, all rock-base, stair entrance, arches and spire tips in frame with generous margin. Actual TRANSPARENT background outside the diorama. No people, monsters, weapons, characters, UI, words, labels, decorative text, sky, giant background eclipse, full-screen smoke, particle clouds or ability illustrations. Do not fill the empty fighting center with props. Single scene, no panels or multiple views.
